algorithm_title: Convert a non negative integer into its binary representation
evidence_summary: This suite provides limited behavioural evidence using one predefined common behavioural test, with covered normal-path behaviour. Frozen program uses fixed integer 23; zero, one, powers of two and larger values cannot be injected without changing the source.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on the predefined common behavioural test, the behaviours exposed by the frozen program interface, and the declared coverage dimensions: normal path.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret behavioural accuracy as agreement for the specific exercised scenario or scenarios, not as strong evidence of general behavioural equivalence.
coverage_limitations: Frozen program uses fixed integer 23; zero, one, powers of two and larger values cannot be injected without changing the source.
manual_review_targets: Confirm assignment corrections remain '=' semantics and bit sequence preserves 23.
